integrity: The general result is established by a finite-dimensional spectral proof. Numerical propagation and eigenspectrum comparisons corroborate the result only for enumerated test parameters; they do not constitute independent mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite number of leaves, one lossy hub, uniform nonzero coupling, pairwise distinct fixed real detunings, fixed positive loss rate, and strictly positive scaled time; no uniform coalescence, added dephasing, or disorder-dependent graph size. Independent publication-priority review has not been performed.
title: Critical-point law for weak-disorder decay on a lossy quantum star
